4.text: During the calving-season the fire-boards are taken from the bag in

5.text: which they are kept and placed behind the frame in the outer tent, so that

6.text: they may protect the calving dams. Pieces of sinew (see Fig. 246) are put

7.text: around the necks of the fire-boards to represent lassos. Sometimes these are

8.text: provided with small bone rings resembling those through which the rope of

9.text: a regular lasso slips in forming the noose. If the herd is divided into two

10.text: parts for fawning, a separate lasso is tied around the neck of every fire-board

11.text: for each, part of the herd. During the ceremonial in the fall, these lassos

12.text: are changed for new ones; but later in the winter they are taken off and

13.text: burned in the fire. If a part of the herd goes astray, the owner will take

14.text: out his fire-boards and request them to find the lost animals. Household

15.text: property (extra tents, sledges, etc.) piled up out of doors may have a fire-

16.text: board fastened to it in some conspicuous place, which will act as a “guar-

17.text: dian.” Such a fire-board may be seen on Plate XXXII, Fig. 1.

18.text: When a new fire-board is made,

19.text: a short ceremony is performed over it,

20.text: which shows clearly that it is looked

21.text: upon as a supernatural herdsman. The

22.text: board is brought home and put behind

23.text: the tent in the usual place of sacrifices.

25.resolved: melha + U+02CA (stress) + U+1D4B (laryngeal) - la + U+02CA (stress) - ul
25.note: Tier-1 gloss. mz draft read the raised marks as ASCII '/' (stress) and 's' (laryngeal): "melha/s-la/ul". At 4x the sequence after 'melha' is stress U+02CA then laryngeal U+1D4B, both before the hyphen, matching the stress-then-laryngeal order documented for this mark pair. `lexicon lookup` returns seven other attestations of the compound's second element as plain "-laˊul" ("man": Maiˊñɪ-qlaˊul 1-073, ottaˊᵋ-laˊulqaitê 1-336, pêrkaᵋˊ-laˊul 2-011, qlaˊul 1-072, vêlɪˊtko-qlaˊul 1-077, Wolvaˊᵋ-laˊul 2-045, yanřaᵋ-laˊul 1-243), none carrying a mark over the u. The 4x crop shows a faint diagonal tick above the u on this line; against seven-for-seven corpus attestation of plain u in this exact suffix, I read it as print noise rather than a breve and keyed plain "u".
